title: Node HTTP reverse proxy
context: node:http reverse proxy in front of an internal API on 127.0.0.1:9000. Only paths under /api/ may be forwarded. verifyToken rejects for invalid tokens and resolves to the user otherwise; the proxy sets X-Internal-User from that user and clients must not be able to set it themselves. Upstream calls time out after 5 seconds, and any upstream failure or timeout must answer the client with 502.
